speaker: dad
text: Welcome to our garden! Let's learn ten flowers.

speaker: mom
text: And please, nobody eat them.

speaker: boy
text: Even if they look like snacks?

speaker: dad
text: First up, a rose. Say rose!

speaker: girl
text: Pretty, but does it bite?

speaker: mom
text: Those are thorns! Look, don't grab.

speaker: mom
text: Sunflower! A giant yellow face.

speaker: boy
text: It's taller than Dad!

speaker: dad
text: I am still growing, thank you!

speaker: dad
text: See the tulip? It looks like a cup.

speaker: girl
text: A cup for fairies!

speaker: mom
text: No fairy tea today, sweetie.

speaker: mom
text: This is a daisy. White petals, yellow middle.

speaker: boy
text: Daisy, will you play with me?

speaker: dad
text: She says maybe tomorrow!

speaker: dad
text: Meet the lily, with big smooth petals.

speaker: girl
text: Lily is my friend's name!

speaker: mom
text: Then give her a flower high-five.

speaker: mom
text: Here's a marigold, bright orange and fluffy.

speaker: boy
text: Is it made of gold?

speaker: dad
text: I wish! We'd be rich!

speaker: dad
text: A lotus grows in water, on a pond.

speaker: girl
text: Does it need swimming lessons?

speaker: mom
text: It has a floating leaf already!

speaker: mom
text: Look closely, this red flower is hibiscus.

speaker: boy
text: Hi, biscuit! Are you yummy?

speaker: dad
text: Hibiscus. No biting flowers!

speaker: dad
text: That purple beauty is an orchid.

speaker: girl
text: Wow, fancy like Mom!

speaker: mom
text: Finally, someone notices my style!

speaker: mom
text: Smell this tiny white jasmine flower.

speaker: boy
text: Mmm! Better than Dad's old socks.

speaker: dad
text: Hey! My socks are famous!

speaker: dad
text: Quick quiz! Rose, sunflower, tulip, daisy, lily!

speaker: mom
text: Marigold, lotus, hibiscus, orchid, jasmine!

speaker: girl
text: We learned ten flowers! Now snacks, please!
